Buying help

Phone and gadget FAQs for Lagos customers.

Find quick answers about current prices, stock confirmation, inspection, pickup, delivery and the products available from Increase Original Super Store.

Contact a branchBrowse product categories

Before you order

Because device stock and prices change, confirm the exact item and fulfilment arrangement with the branch before payment.

How do I get the current price?

Choose a product and tap “Ask on WhatsApp.” The model name will be included in your message so our sales team can confirm today’s price and stock.

Can I inspect or pick up a device?

Message or call us to confirm the available device and the current pickup arrangement before you set out.

Can I request a device that is not displayed?

Yes. Send the exact model or your budget on WhatsApp and the team will confirm currently available options.

Do you deliver outside Lagos?

Contact us to check delivery availability for your location. Confirm the destination and delivery arrangement with our sales team before payment.

What kinds of gadgets do you sell?

Increase Original Super Store supplies phones, foldables, tablets, laptops and useful accessories across several popular brands.

Do you publish exact prices online?

Some products have fast-changing prices and stock. Use the product catalogue to choose a model, then ask the relevant branch to confirm the current price, condition, storage and available colour.

Still deciding?

Send your model or budget.

Tell the team what you want to use the device for and they can help you compare current options.
